saved.next_step: Final round with the CTO next week

transcript:
[00:00:02] Speaker 1: Thanks for making the time. I lead the platform team here. Could you walk me through an incident you owned end to end?
[00:00:11] You: Sure. Last spring our Kubernetes cluster ran out of pod IPs during a traffic spike. I saw pods stuck in Pending, traced it to the CNI subnet and added a secondary CIDR range within the hour.
[00:00:29] Speaker 1: And how did you stop it from happening again?
[00:00:32] You: An alert on free IPs per subnet, a runbook, and prefix delegation so every node gets a larger block.
[00:00:41] Speaker 2: I'll jump in on observability. What does a good on-call dashboard look like to you?
[00:00:47] You: The four golden signals per service first, then saturation of the shared dependencies: the database, the queue, DNS.
[00:00:58] Speaker 1: Great. Next step would be a system design round with two engineers from the team.

insight.headline: Incident ownership is your strongest story; capacity numbers are what's missing
